faqs.question: Is there really a free plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The free store check runs a one-time simulation of your top 10 products across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini and returns a Win Rate Report. No credit card is required.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Compete, Scale, and Dominate?
faqs.answer: Compete covers up to 100 products with competitor comparisons and manual optimization suggestions. Scale covers up to 1,000 products with listing suggestions you can review and publish using Apply. Dominate includes Scale and is the plan tied to the Techstars offer. The Y Combinator offer can apply to any flat subscription. Simulations are on demand; the product does not promise a scheduled cadence.

faqs.question: What is the difference between pay-as-you-go and a subscription?
faqs.answer: Pay-as-you-go has no upfront fee and uses a standard 3% performance fee, capped at $500 a month, under the attribution rules below. Compete, Scale and Dominate charge a flat monthly price with no performance fee. Choose the billing model that fits your team.

faqs.question: How does the pay-as-you-go performance fee work?
faqs.answer: An order counts if it carries an explicit AI attribution signal, or if any AI-referred visit reached your store in the preceding 7 days. This is a store-level window, not individual shopper attribution. The standard fee is 3% of qualifying orders, capped at $500 per calendar month. Visits have no fee. A payment method is only requested when a fee is due. The free check and flat subscriptions carry no performance fee.

faqs.question: Can I change plans or cancel later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start with the free check, activate pay-as-you-go, or choose a flat subscription. Plans are month to month and you can cancel. Talk to us to scope an enterprise pilot before agreeing its terms.

faqs.question: When should I talk to sales instead of self-serving?
faqs.answer: When you run several stores or brands, have thousands of products, need a security review, or want a pilot with targets agreed in writing.

faqs.question: What is the EU Presence bundle?
faqs.answer: The bundle combines EU Presence’s GDPR representative, GPSR responsible person and Privacy Center Plus with ecentic Dominate. The existing bundle offers a 20% discount, with no minimums and no setup fees. Use the bundle call link to discuss it.

faqs.question: What happens to our data if we leave?
faqs.answer: The Privacy policy retains data while your account is active. Disconnecting a store deletes its access tokens immediately; imported products remain for simulation history unless you request deletion. Deleting your account permanently deletes the profile, credentials, stores, tokens, imported products, simulation results, optimization history, reports, UCP profile, agent orders including shopper details, and Google Merchant Center connection records. Shopify’s shop/redact webhook deletes that shop’s store data, products and associated records. Where tax or accounting rules require billing records, the order reference and amount are retained, not shopper contact or address details. The policy specifies no separate deletion turnaround or backup purge period.

faqs.question: Is anything billed that we did not ask for?
faqs.answer: No plan is billed without activation. Plans are month to month. Under the standard pay-as-you-go terms, a 3% fee applies to an order with an explicit AI attribution signal or an order within 7 days of an AI-referred visit to your store, up to $500 per calendar month. The referral window covers the store, not an identified shopper. Flat subscriptions have no performance fee.

faqs.question: Do you sign a DPA?
faqs.answer: Discuss your DPA requirements with us during scoping. Confirm the agreement and signing arrangements before sharing personal data.
